name: Creator outreach drafting
summary: A brand marketer gets a first message and three follow-ups for each chosen creator, written for the way that creator can be reached, opening on something they made and stating only the brand's standard offer. A person reads every message and sends it from the brand's own account.

sources.title: The creator outreach method in Fully Powered AI's Influencer Marketing set (Fully-Powered-AI/influencer-marketing, MIT): a first message built from the one thing the creator made, why them, what their audience gets, the offer in a line and one easy question; channel versions; three follow-ups then stop; vetting verdicts respected; no product statements in outreach; and a person who reads and sends every message.

sources.contribution: A first message followed by a short run of follow-ups that each add something new, get shorter and make a no easy, ending with a polite closing note; a short direct-message version and a formal version for a manager; a decline that ends one campaign's messages kept apart from a request never to be contacted.

Never opening on the sender; opening on the creator's name and a dated thing they made that anyone can see; never claiming a history with the creator the sender does not have; no link in the first message; a small question as the ask.
The line between what outreach may discuss and what the written agreement settles, so that terms such as fees, usage rights and exclusivity are left to the agreement.

Its port of the KOL Pricing framework by Antonia (Antoniaiaiaiaia/kol-pricing, MIT): the engage, negotiate and skip handling, in which a creator marked skip is approached only when asked for, and then only with the basic deal; and, from its outreach section, a message that refers to one recent post, stays within a set length, carries no hype, emoji or exclamation marks, and ends on a low-effort ask.

From its outreach section: approaching creators individually rather than in bulk, with each note pointing to the creator's own work, the reason the brand chose them and the benefit to their followers.
